title: Only 7% Pass This Intelligence Test
summary: Patterns, number rules, word links and spatial traps test how quickly your reasoning finds the hidden rule.

landing.intro: Patterns, codes, word links and logic traps collide. How long can your reasoning stay one step ahead?

about.body:
This worldwide entertainment challenge brings together ten carefully selected puzzles covering patterns, numerical rules, verbal connections, spatial reasoning, attention and logical deduction. It is designed to feel playful and demanding rather than like a formal aptitude exam.

Each puzzle has one answer supported by the information shown. The interaction changes regularly, so you may need to identify a rule, compare clues, transform a symbol, calculate mentally or notice a small inconsistency.

Your Intelligence Test Score is the percentage of these entertainment puzzles you solve correctly. It describes this attempt only and does not measure your actual intelligence, IQ, aptitude or educational ability.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Complete ten carefully selected questions in one focused challenge.
Choose one answer each time. Correctness remains hidden until the final reveal.
Reveal your result, skill breakdown and complete answer review after the final question.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This is not a standardised intelligence, IQ, aptitude, educational or psychological assessment.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your intelligence-test score and three-area breakdown are ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: The Systems Mastermind
profile-1.copy: You consistently spotted hidden structure across very different types of problems. Patterns, constraints and small details tended to click into place quickly.

profile-2.title: The Precision Thinker
profile-2.copy: You combined strong rule detection with careful attention to detail. Even when the format changed, you usually found the important clue.

profile-3.title: The Pattern Navigator
profile-3.copy: You found your way through most of the vault by recognising how information connected. Your strongest moments came when there was a clear underlying rule to uncover.

profile-4.title: The Adaptive Solver
profile-4.copy: You handled a broad mix of challenges and adapted well when the puzzle style changed. Some locks opened instantly; others needed a different angle.

profile-5.title: The Curious Analyst
profile-5.copy: You cracked a solid share of the vault and kept working when the rule was not immediately obvious. Some puzzle styles clicked quickly, while others rewarded a second look.

profile-6.title: The Exploratory Solver
profile-6.copy: Some of the vault's rules proved difficult, but you still cracked puzzles across several challenge types. Reviewing the missed clues may reveal a few patterns that become much easier on a second look.

score.passed: You passed the Intelligence Test challenge!
